title: Inflation Target Renewal: 4% (±2%) Retained Till March 2031

items: **Statutory Target Mandate:** Central Government officially renewed the inflation-targeting framework for the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) at **4.0% Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation with a tolerance band of ±2% (2% to 6%)**.

**Five-Year Validity Period:** The renewed statutory inflation mandate covers the 5-year period from **1 April 2026 to 31 March 2031** (retaining the framework originally notified in 2016 under Section 45ZA of the RBI Act, 1934).

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → Inflation target renewed unchanged at 4% (tolerance band 2%-6%), valid for 5 years till 31 March 2031.
